title: US sends third aircraft carrier to Middle East amid stalemate in Iran war
summary: Deployment underscores evolving complexity of Trump’s war against Iran as US midterm elections loom The US military is dispatching a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East, as President Donald Trump warned new strikes against Iran could be on the horizon. The deployment, which includes a specialist amphibious attack group, underscores the rapidly evolving dynamic of Trump’s war against Iran as midterm elections in the US loom large.
